40l-chemical-dosing-tank.shortDescription: 40L square rotationally moulded polyethylene chemical dosing tank for compact water-treatment and dosing installations.
40l-chemical-dosing-tank.description:
A **40L square polyethylene chemical dosing tank** for compact water-treatment and chemical-dosing installations.

Its square footprint makes it practical where floor space is limited, while the rotationally moulded polyethylene body provides a simple standalone chemical-storage and dosing vessel.

- 40L nominal capacity
- Approx. 340 × 380 mm footprint
- Approx. 390 mm overall height
- Approx. 150 mm top port
- Rotationally moulded polyethylene construction
- Standalone square dosing tank
features: Suitable for compatible water-treatment chemical dosing applications
recommendedFor: Compatible chlorine, antiscalant and pH-dosing applications

compliance.note: Confirm chemical compatibility and site-specific containment requirements for the stored chemical, volume, installation and jurisdiction.
